create_entity_agent: create an EntityAgent with an acting component and optional context components
run_entity_agent_act: run the act method on an EntityAgent to produce an action attempt through its lifecycle
run_entity_agent_observe: run the observe method on an EntityAgent to process an observation through its lifecycle
get_entity_agent_state: get the serialized state dictionary of an EntityAgent including all component states
set_entity_agent_state: set the state of an EntityAgent by restoring act and context component states
